mapper.select: SELECT id, trade_date, snapshot_time, provider_quote_time, item_count, quality_status FROM market_sector_ranking_batch WHERE market_code = #{marketCode} AND snapshot_type = 'CLOSE' AND quality_status NOT IN ('BLOCKED_AUTH', 'BLOCKED_PERMISSION', 'BACKOFF') ORDER BY snapshot_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_sector_ranking_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
